requirements.text: The umbrella will be a web-based menu system allowing the user to choose between the games.
The umbrella will be a singular component, providing links to projects relating to fractions, decimals, and percents in a format accessible over the World Wide Web.
An introductory movie to set up the storyline.
A main menu, including a brief help section.
A series of fraction questions (testing arithmetic, equivalence, graphical interpretation, and improper versus proper fraction skills) that sequentially form a storyline related to the introduction.
An ending scene where the user's score is calculated and ranked, with an option to quit the game or try again.
A component accessible over the World Wide Web will allow the series of fraction questions to be updated by an administrator of the game.
The user's score must be kept as local data within the game so that the results may be given at the end of the game.
Input will consist entirely of mouse clicks for the user to choose answer options and to set preferences.
Output will be sounds and animations through Flash movies to acknowledge success or failure in answering the fraction questions.
There is an option to skip the introduction, if desired.
No portion of the interface will require the keyboard; all input will be accomplished via mouse clicks.
The component will generate a text file on the game server, which is used by the game sequence to dynamically load question data.
The component opens the specified S2S product in a separate window.
The system shall enforce a minimum password length of 8 characters and transmit administrative credentials over HTTPS to prevent interception.
The system shall ensure that the generated text file is stored in a non-executable directory and is only writable by the authenticated administrative process.
The application shall implement server-side validation for all inputs received from the Question Updater to prevent injection attacks.
The system shall maintain 99.9% availability during school hours and implement error handling to gracefully recover from interrupted network connections during game sessions.
The Question Updater shall implement password-protected access using HTTPS to ensure administrative credentials and game content are transmitted securely.
The system shall provide a technical manual detailing the data schema for the question text files and the process for updating game assets without requiring recompilation of the Flash source.
The system shall support at least 30 concurrent users accessing the game simultaneously without exceeding a 2-second response time for interactive elements.
The main game movie shall begin playback within 30 seconds on a standard 56kbps modem connection.
The system shall support at least 50 concurrent users accessing the game and administrative functions without degradation in response time.
The Question Updater shall commit changes to the server-side text file and reflect updates in the game sequence within 2 seconds of administrator submission.
